name: skrun-runner
description: In-machine RPC server bundled inside the skrun-runtime Docker image. Standalone (NOT a pnpm workspace member) — see infra/runtime-image/runner/README.md for rationale. The @skrun-dev/runtime dependency is injected as a tarball at Docker build time via the RUNTIME_TGZ build arg (produced by the GHCR workflow via `pnpm --filter @skrun-dev/runtime pack`).
